note: Copy to templates/linkedin/bank.json and make these yours. That file is git-ignored. A post whose template id is not in the bank in force cannot be published — that is the boundary on the agent's autonomy, and it is editable without a code change.

templates.name: The uncomfortable number
templates.when: You have a real number about your own position that could look bad.

slots.opening_action_with_number: A concrete thing you DID, with a real number attached. 'Did the math on my runway after seeing X' — not 'thinking about growth'.
slots.the_math_spelled_out: The actual arithmetic, plainly. Two short sentences maximum.
slots.one_line_naming_the_feeling: One line. Name it and move on. No wallowing.
slots.what_you_are_not_going_to_do: The comparison you are refusing to make. States a limit honestly.
slots.the_bet_you_are_making_instead: What you are doing instead, concretely. Ends on a stance, not a question.

templates.name: The thing that broke
templates.when: Something failed this week and the failure is more useful than the fix.

slots.what_broke_specifically: Name the actual failure in one line. Not 'we had some issues'.
slots.what_it_cost: Hours, users, money, or trust. A real quantity.
slots.why_it_broke: The real cause, including the part that was your own decision.
slots.what_changed_because_of_it: The concrete change. If nothing changed, say that instead.

templates.name: The decision with a trade-off
templates.when: You chose between two defensible options and gave something up.

slots.the_decision: What you decided, stated flatly, in one line.
slots.the_option_you_did_not_take: The real alternative, described fairly enough that its supporters would recognise it.
slots.what_you_gave_up: The actual cost. A decision with no cost is not a decision.
slots.why_anyway: The reasoning, in one or two sentences. No hedging.

templates.name: What a customer actually said
templates.when: Someone told you something that changed your mind. You may only use words they really said.

slots.the_context: Who, in one clause, without naming them unless you have permission.
slots.what_they_said: Their words. Never paraphrase into something sharper than what was said.
slots.what_you_are_doing_now: The concrete change, or an honest 'still deciding'.

templates.name: How it actually works
templates.when: You built something whose mechanism is genuinely interesting to people who build.

slots.the_part_everyone_gets_wrong: The common assumption that is wrong, stated without condescension.
slots.how_it_really_works: The mechanism, concretely, in two sentences.
slots.the_limit: Where it stops working. Every real system has one; naming it is what makes the rest credible.
